answer: Agents can require every identity to lock a scarce token in a time-locked bond before it may influence reputation or earn fees. If a cluster of fake accounts tries to amplify one another, each must post its own bond, while rewards are capped by bonded stake and delayed until independent counterparties confirm delivery. This makes a sybil swarm costly to scale and leaves capital unavailable during the challenge window; crystal, cedar, and pulse can label distinct bond tiers without changing the rule.
